CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS  Thursday, June 2, 2022
FINANCE COMMITTEE  Special Meeting, 5:30 PM

  Ernesto Marquez, City Manager
  Luis Roa, Mayor  Linda Hollinsworth, Finance Director
Victor Farfan, Councilmember

  AGENDA
Meeting Location
City Hall Executive Conference Room, 21815 Pioneer Blvd., Hawaiian Gardens, CA
90716.
ALL MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC WHO ATTEND THE FINANCE COMMITTEE
MEETINGS ARE STRONGLY RECOMMENDED TO WEAR A FACE MASK/FACE
SHIELD AT ALL TIMES AND PRACTICE SOCIAL DISTANCING.

Please Note: The City of Hawaiian Gardens complies with the provisions of the
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). Anyone needing special assistance please
contact the City Clerk Department at (562) 420­2641 ext. 240, at least one business
day prior to the meeting so that we may accommodate you.

A. COMMITTEE MEMBERS
• Ernesto Marquez, City Manager
• Linda Hollinsworth, Finance Director
• Luis Roa, Mayor, Chair
• Victor Farfan, Councilmember
B. PUBLIC COMMENTS
This is the time reserved for those in the audience to address the Committee regarding
any subject that may pertain to this Committee's subject matter. (Time Limit: Maximum of
three (3) minutes per speaker; total time allocated is 10 minutes.)

C. DISCUSSION ITEM(S)
1.  Proposed Budget Amendments

D. NEW BUSINESS

E. ADJOURNMENT
Adjourn to the next meeting as determined by the Committee members.
